text:
mika: Quick FYI — onboarding run for telltale-v1 (fp16 -> int8 per-channel) finished. Seeing a pretty consistent drop in semantic recall vs fp16 on our standard holdout :/
raj: Can you paste the run id + quick numbers?
diane: Also which dataset / metric? recall@k? silhouette?
mika: run_id: rl-2026-03-21-tell-07. Holdout=wiki-multilang-10k. Metrics (fp16 -> int8): recall@1 0.69 -> 0.62, recall@5 0.90 -> 0.84, avg cosine sim shift -0.03, silhouette 0.21 -> 0.17.
raj: Oof. That's larger than the usual noise. Which quant path did you use? symmetric per-channel?
mika: Per-channel asymmetric, clamp=6bit-ish config (we used the new calibrator branch). Faiss index: IVF4096,HNSW, metric=cosine. Batchsize during embed=128, microbatching on serving=32.
akshay: Are you normalizing vectors before KNN? int8 can change scale. Try L2 norm post-quant and then re-eval. Also try a float32 PQ baseline (for comparison).
diane: Good call. Also short-query recall tends to regress more — can we split by query length (<=10 tokens) and long queries?
mika: Yep I have that broken out: short queries recall@1 down 9 pts, long queries down 3 pts. Seems concentrated on short tail.
raj: Can you paste the eval command so I can repro locally?
mika: Sure — snippet:```
run_eval \  
  --model telltale-v1-int8 \  
  --holdout wiki-multilang-10k \  
  --index faiss://ivf4096_hnsw\  
  --metric recall@k,cosine,silhouette \  
  --batch 128 \  
  --normalize true
```
(most of the actual run args are in the job record rl-2026-03-21-tell-07)
embed-bot: automated-report: recall_drop=6pts@5; short_query_drop=9pts@1; affected_segments=multilang-xx,config=per-channel-int8. See /runs/rl-2026-03-21-tell-07 for artifacts.
diane: Can we run a tiny ablation: same quant but with L2 norm forced, and same with float32 cache for top-64 re-rank? That will tell if it's a scale/precision re-rank issue.
akshay: Also test quantization with symmetric-per-tensor — sometimes it helps for attention-like weights in projection layers (embedding heads can be weird).
mika: Scheduling both ablations now — kicked off 2 jobs, expect results in ~45m. I'll post numbers + a UMAP of before/after. @raj @diane @akshay any other quick checks?
raj: Add a 5k synthetic short-query probe (generated paraphrases) — if that reproduces at scale it's a red flag for quant mapping.
diane: And add cluster purity (kmeans k=50) — we need to know if local neighborhoods are preserved.
mika: Added both probes to the run. Will update when jobs finish. Thanks :thumbsup:
raj: Thx — if it looks like per-channel mapping then maybe try the calibration dataset with more short examples.
mika: Yeah will widen calibrator to 50% short queries on next pass if needed.
embed-bot: job rl-2026-03-21-tell-07 status: reruns queued (2 ablations). Notifying participants when done.
mika: Dropping a quick note: attaching the first UMAP in the run artifacts — short-query clusters are visibly tighter in fp16 and more diffuse in int8. Putting link in run. Will follow up with final numbers.
raj: Perfect. Keep us posted.
mika: Will do — tagging this thread with #embed-onboard and moving to incident if recall_drop >8pts overall.
